intro: Gahrron's Withering is a corrupted farmstead nestled along the eastern border of the Western Plaguelands near the path to the Eastern Plaguelands. Once a thriving piece of Lordaeron farmland called Gahrron's Quickening, it is now occupied by the Scourge and anchored by a massive cauldron pumping virulent plague vapors into the air.

p: Before the Third War ruined the kingdom of Lordaeron, this estate was known as Gahrron's Quickening, named after its master, Del Gahrron. Its fertile fields yielded grain for the realm until the Cult of the Damned and the Scourge swept across the land. Renamed Gahrron's Withering in bitter mockery of its past vitality, the homestead now stands broken and derelict. Haunting visions, wailing wraiths, and restless spirits wander the ruined outbuildings, overseen by Scourge overseers sworn to the Lich King.
